messages:
alice: Heads up — getting a SCIM deprovision loop for a handful of orgs after yesterday's RBAC prune. IdP is returning 403 for deprovision calls. Audit log shows KMS decrypt errors for SCIM extId mapping :

bob: timeline? did the RBAC change touch the service-account that runs the SCIM connector?

alice: change was a role prune + removal of a ‘scim-admin’ grant from a service-account group. PR #4521 merged ~08:10 UTC. Failures started ~08:12 according to logs.

carol: can you paste the exact error from our logs?

alice: here are the proxy logs (redacted):
```
2026-03-21T08:12:22Z ERROR scim-sync service=provisioner idp=okta err="KMS: decrypt failed: access denied" request_id=abc123 user_extid=svc-scim-01
2026-03-21T08:12:23Z WARN  scim-sync deprovision retry=1 user_extid=svc-scim-01 idp_resp=403
```

dave: :thinking: looks like the SCIM connector tried to decrypt stored mapping context (extId -> internal id) and KMS refused because the service-account lost decrypt permission. That would cause deprovision to repeatedly fail and retry.

carol: confirm: the connector runs as k8s SA `platform-scim` in namespace `idp-connectors`, right?

alice: yes. Running `kubectl get sa platform-scim -o yaml` shows it still exists. But IAM role binding was changed in the prune.

bob: if it's an IAM role binding removal, KMS will return AccessDenied. We should check the KMS policy and the IAM principal mapping. Who has the KMS audit link?

alice: link: https://console.company/kms/audit?cursor=2026-03-21T08:12

security-bot: ALERT: KMS_ACCESS_DENIED for principal arn:aws:sts::111111111111:assumed-role/platform-scim-role/2026-03-21T08:12:21Z (3 hits)

carol: ok. Short remediation plan: 1) temporarily re-grant decrypt to platform-scim role, 2) let SCIM flush pending deprovision queue, 3) create a follow-up to do least-priv change with scoped condition keys, 4) audit to ensure no other SAs lost access.

dave: are there any compliance concerns re-granting? need approval from security if it's >5 minutes.

alice: i pinged legal/compliance in DMs and got verbal go for emergency rollback. Will escalate in case they require an audit note.

bob: commands I ran to validate mapping: 
```
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/scim-mappings | head -n 40
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-03-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-21T09:00:00Z
```
I see the deny happened exactly at 08:12:21 for principal `platform-scim-role` and there was a concurrent `iam:DetachRolePolicy` for group `svc-ops-prune` at 08:10:05.

carol: ":+1:" If we re-grant, add a session tag condition so only the connector pod instances can use it. Also rotate the mapping envelope key after we reconcile.

alice: rolling a temporary policy to re-add kms:Decrypt for platform-scim-role now. patch applied at 08:14:03 UTC.

security-bot: POLICY_CHANGE: KMS key alias/scim-mappings policy updated by alice (web-ui) at 2026-03-21T08:14:03Z

bob: SCIM logs show deprovision retries succeeding now: `200 OK deprovision user_extid=svc-scim-01` at 08:14:47. Looks like backlog is draining.

dave: great — can we snapshot the current key policy and capture CloudTrail trail for the audit? I'll open the incident ticket.

alice: uploading snapshots to S3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-003-scim-rbac-recover. Also creating incident: INC-2026-003.

carol: post-mortem notes we should include: root cause = RBAC prune removed role binding used by connector; contributing = no guardrail preventing removal of roles tagged as 'service-account-critical'; remediation = tag-based deny in IAM for delete on service-account-role, implement pre-merge CI check to detect RBAC changes touching known infra SAs, rotate envelope key.

bob: question: do we need to rotate the KMS CMK key (alias/scim-mappings) cryptographically, or just rewrap mapping blobs with a new data key?

dave: prefer rewrap (generate new data key, re-encrypt extId mapping store) — avoids full CMK rotation. Add a migration job that reads each mapping and re-encrypts with new envelope key, then mark old mapping as retired.

alice: will schedule a low-traffic migration window. For now, leaving temporary decrypt grant but it will expire in 2 hours via automated revoke lambda.

security-bot: SCHEDULED_TASK: temporary-policy-revoke lambda scheduled at 2026-03-21T10:14:03Z

carol: any sign of duplicated deprovisions or entitlements getting lost? we should scan rows for users that had partial deprovision attempts.

bob: wrote a quick query to flag half-deprov states: `SELECT extid, status, last_attempt FROM scim_mappings WHERE status != 'deleted' AND last_attempt > '2026-03-21T08:00:00Z'` returns 6 rows; I manually reconciled 4, left 2 for automated job.

alice: confirming backlog drained, no new 403s after policy patch. Closing emergency. Will add follow-up tasks in INC-2026-003: RBAC guardrails, mapping rewrap job, CI checks, postmortem writeup.

dave: thanks team. Please add timeline and approvals to the incident ticket.

alice: added timeline + compliance note. Marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
